description: Sapphire stage ordinals for a well, with the gate marked. Stages without a (ttr, rampdown_start] window can hold no anomalies, and the label says so rather than leaving the user to wonder why the chart is empty.
sql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT '-1' AS value, 'Select stage' AS label, 0 AS sort_order
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT CAST(CAST(s.stage_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS TEXT) AS value,
       CAST(CAST(s.stage_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS TEXT)
         || CASE WHEN s.ttr_ts IS NULL OR s.rampdown_start_ts IS NULL
                 THEN ' (no gate)' ELSE '' END AS label,
       1 AS sort_order
FROM featurestore:nextier_substage_sapphire_sept3_stage_summary_v2 s
WHERE s.well_name = :well_name
  AND CAST(:well_name AS TEXT) NOT IN ('', '__ALL__')
  AND s.stage_num IS NOT NULL
) q
ORDER BY q.sort_order, CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE PRECISION)
